$comment: St. John's step 8b (Memorial Hall, the library, rebuilt to the owner's direction): the ordered MapMaker steps, as a driver replays them on the map (Import, the Outliner's search and a click on the row, Delete, the Set pieces tab with R, the set piece inspector's Options and Materials one a selection, the Paths tool's list and Style, the Props tab and the entity inspector's X / Z / Facing, Export). Cells are 8 m; a piece's x, y are its anchor cell, rot its quarter turns. A prop's height null: left on the ground where MapMaker puts it. Ids are the map's as it stood on main at 98184628; on a newer map check them first.

steps.what: the old hall's gable roof, seven courses
the oak that stood in front of the hall's north end, seen from the walk
the hall's south end: its closed end south, its spiral stair in the east cell
the hall's bay with the arch in its east wall and the porch recessed behind it, and the faceted end under the spire, north
the small stucco wing against the faceted end's north face, west of its windows; its gable, door and steps north
the walk that passes the arch (north-south, from the lawn to Stangeland / Cord) in brick, as the walk from the court
the bronze bird on its pedestal on the lawn east of the walk
a dark marker stone on the lawn west of the walk
